user_query: I'm planning a family gathering and I want to make it memorable. Can you help me find a suitable venue for the event and suggest some fun activities for both kids and adults? Additionally, provide me with entertaining comments made by a specific username on Reddit to keep everyone engaged.

TaskList.description: Search for suitable venues for the family gathering based on location and capacity.
Suggest fun activities for kids and adults, tailored to the chosen venue.
Fetch entertaining comments made by a specific username on Reddit to use during the gathering.
